title: gatewatch: audit standard docs/CONSTITUTION.md missing from repo (and CLAUDE.md) — no gate standard on file
description: Evidence: repo HEAD of origin/main is 2b55f1276a310330b50363898b45b489faa7c75a (2026-10-08T11:49:41+02:00, 'chore(warren): schedule weekly documentationwatch (#11)'). 'git ls-tree -r main --name-only | grep -iE constitution|claude' returns nothing (exit 1) — neither docs/CONSTITUTION.md nor CLAUDE.md exists anywhere in the tree, and no prior commit in history introduced one. gatewatch's mandate (Article IX: protection of the constitution and its audit surface) names docs/CONSTITUTION.md as the audit standard; with it absent, every future patrol of this repo runs without a citable standard, and Articles I/II/III/VII/VIII/IX cannot be cited or enforced. CLAUDE.md, the designated fallback standard, is also absent, so there is no fallback to audit against. No tracker reference or sign-off can be verified because there is no .canopy/ or seed history to point at (sd search gatewatch: no issues match). Required: restore docs/CONSTITUTION.md to the repo (or document its deliberate removal with an explicit human sign-off) so gate/ratchet/taste gates have a citable standard.
